name: Lightdrift search guide
use: Public product contract for the saved search response shape: results[], asset_id, title, width/height, file/thumb and the rights object (license, license_verbatim, attribution, attribution_required, provenance_url).

name: HTML Living Standard: the figure and figcaption elements
use: Public specification for the figure/figcaption grouping and semantics used to present one result per figure with its declared caption.

name: HTML Living Standard: the img element
use: Public specification for the img attributes used: src, alt, width, height, loading and decoding (no external resources).
